title: A decimal through its text to a double is correctly rounded
description: `CAST(CAST(x AS STRING) AS DOUBLE)`, as the writer casts a decimal to a double, gives the nearest double: 0.1, 2.5, 0.0 for `-0.0`, 1e38 for 38 nines, and 0.3 for 0.30000000000000000444089209850062616169 (closer to 0.29999999999999998890 than to 0.30000000000000004441).

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark`'s `_writer_probes`, run locally with ANSI on and off, on the folded and the codegen path, which agree on each. pyspark 4.3.0, Java 21.0.13, macOS arm64, session time zone UTC (BASE_CONF); probes.json's header records the earlier homelab run.
